chris showed up right on time for both of our pool cleaning service calls. he quickly found two problems—one was a leaking skimmer, which he fixed right away, and the other was a broken pool vacuum line under the pool deck. chris did all the repairs neatly and really made sure everything was done right. we’re very happy with the pool cleaning service and would definitely recommend them to anyone needing pool care in this hot texas weather.

The team arrived right on time, just as promised, and finished all the pool work quickly and efficiently. They made sure to leave everything tidy when they were done. I’m really happy with the whole experience!

We are so happy with the way our pool looks after Plano Pool Service started taking care of it. Brandon was great to work with, and our pool is cleaner than we ever imagined. We won't use anyone else for our pool cleaning needs.

Plano Pool Service did a great job replacing our pool pump. David came out to check our old pump that had stopped working, and had it replaced soon after. They arrived on time, finished the job as promised, and were friendly and reliable. Highly recommend if you need pool repairs!

Plano Pool Service has consistently offered excellent value and insightful guidance on my pool and its upkeep for more than two decades. The team, including Tanner in the local Plano store and David at the service office, are respectful, reliable, and trustworthy. I have developed a high level of trust in their services.

When my pool actuator stopped working right before a freeze, I needed it fixed fast. My regular warranty contact didn’t get back to me for a few days, and my weekly pool cleaning service wanted to charge a $95 trip fee on top of parts and labor. I decided to call another pool cleaning company, and Grant came out the very next day, fixed the problem, and charged a fair price. I’ll definitely call them again for any pool repairs I need.

I recently had my pool pump fixed and Tanner did a fantastic job. He completed the repair in under an hour, which really saved me both time and money. While his communication style might come off as a bit rough, I appreciate that he’s a dedicated worker who knows his stuff. I highly recommend his service, and I would definitely choose them again for my pool needs.

David from Plano Pool Service did an exceptional job transitioning our in-ground saltwater pool from using filters to a sand filter system. The team is amazing! We rely on them for our regular pool cleaning and related repairs, and our pool always looks clean and welcoming. They are consistently professional and quick to respond, and their proactive approach ensures that any issues are handled promptly. We feel fortunate to have found such a great service for our pool.

reviews.text: We recently had our pool resurfaced by Plano Pool Service in Plano. From the start, the team was fantastic—Chris gave us a detailed quote, and Austin was incredibly helpful in helping us choose the best finish and waterline tile for our pool. Christopher made sure the billing and warranty details were very clear and simple to understand. The project was overseen with great care, and we were always kept up to date along the way, which made the whole process easy and stress-free. The actual pool refinishing was done by three skilled crews, and their work was impressive. When they finished, they left everything cleaner than before they arrived! We’re excited to enjoy our beautiful, newly updated pool for years to come.
reviews.author: Erica Freeman

reviews.text: Plano Pool Service did an excellent job starting up my pool and provided a very detailed walkthrough of everything I needed to know! Eric was very knowledgeable and quickly handled any questions or small issues that came up with my new pool. The team was professional and made sure my pool was clean, balanced, and ready for us to enjoy during the hot Texas summer. I would highly recommend this company to anyone needing pool cleaning, maintenance, or a new pool startup. Their service went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect!
reviews.author: Tucker Davila

reviews.text: INCREDIBLE POOL SERVICE! Chris showed true professionalism and really went the extra mile to give us a fantastic experience. He arrived right on time and did a complete inspection of our pool equipment and water system, which was not only smooth but also finished quicker than we thought it would. Chris even took care of some leftover debris that someone else had missed around the pool area! To our surprise, he also cleaned out our pool filters and boosted our water flow so much that our pool jets are working better than ever. We had tried everything ourselves, like using cleaning chemicals and scrubbing off calcium buildup, but nothing worked—our water flow was weak and the pool wasn’t circulating right. After Chris worked his magic, our pool water pressure is back to normal and we couldn’t be happier! He was friendly and easy to talk to, making the whole process stress-free. We highly recommend Plano Pool Service to anyone looking for great pool care. From start to finish, everything went smoothly and we are so pleased with the results.
reviews.author: T Parsons

reviews.text: After my old pool in Plano started leaking from a bad crack, I tried fixing it myself a few times, but nothing worked. There were no surprise fees, and they made sure every detail was taken care of. Everyone was friendly, professional, and really listened to what I needed. I highly recommend their pool services to anyone looking for great results.

reviews.text: here’s a great example of top-notch pool service from someone who really goes the extra mile. after another pool company left our pool heater only halfway fixed and told us we’d need a pricey new igniter, i reached out to plano pool service for help. ardie answered my call and was super helpful—before setting up a visit, he suggested a quick test. he asked me to try running the pool heater with the filter cartridge taken out, just to see if it still gave the 'service heater' message. sure enough, after i tried it, the heater worked just fine! i ended up swapping out my old filter for the better one ardie recommended, and now everything runs perfectly. i didn't even need to schedule a service visit or spend extra money. really happy with the honest advice and friendly support.

The new color we chose for our pool looks absolutely amazing—it's exactly what we were hoping for. The whole process was smooth and professional. We will definitely call on them again for any future pool service needs.
reviews.author: molly morgan

reviews.text: After searching for pool service companies, I came across this review page for Plano Pool Service. I noticed a negative review at the top, which didn’t match my own experience at all, so I wanted to share what happened with my pool. We decided to add a pool to our courtyard area while building our home, even though the space was small and the access for equipment was pretty tight. I was a bit nervous about whether the house or fence would get damaged during the dig, so I came home to check things out. Mike and Eric showed up with smaller equipment and did the whole job without leaving a single scratch anywhere. It was really impressive to see how careful and skilled they were. When it came time to choose the stone coping, I picked a pattern, but later my wife wanted something different. They changed it out for us with no hassle at all. The pool came out looking amazing, and we use it almost every day, especially with the hot Texas weather. Even after several years, the pool still looks brand new and we haven’t had any maintenance problems at all. The design fit perfectly into our small courtyard, and it’s become one of our favorite spots at home. I highly recommend this company for anyone looking to design and build a pool that fits their space and needs.
reviews.author: Cheyenne Buck

We will definitely call on them again for any future pool service needs.

chris showed up right on time for both of our pool cleaning service calls. he quickly found two problems—one was a leaking skimmer, which he fixed right away, and the other was a broken pool vacuum line under the pool deck. chris did all the repairs neatly and really made sure everything was done right. we’re very happy with the pool cleaning service and would definitely recommend them to anyone needing pool care in this hot texas weather.

The team arrived right on time, just as promised, and finished all the pool work quickly and efficiently. They made sure to leave everything tidy when they were done. They removed the old diving board, put in a new handrail, set up the auto-fill system, and installed a new pool light, exactly as we discussed. Mike was very respectful and the price was fair. I’m really happy with the whole experience!

We are so happy with the way our pool looks after Plano Pool Service started taking care of it. Brandon was great to work with, and our pool is cleaner than we ever imagined. If you need any kind of pool cleaning or maintenance, give them a call—you won't regret it. They offer weekly service, and our pool always looks fantastic. We won't use anyone else for our pool cleaning needs.

Plano Pool Service did a great job replacing our pool pump. David came out to check our old pump that had stopped working, and had it replaced soon after. They arrived on time, finished the job as promised, and were friendly and reliable. Highly recommend if you need pool repairs!

i needed black algae taken care of in my pool (they handled it perfectly!). my pool tiles had fallen off a while ago, and they replaced the ones i saved, then found matching tiles for the rest. grant did the tile work, and he was awesome. the price was really good too. tanner also came out and programmed my pool motor so the cleaner would work better. i highly recommend these guys—they really know pools and do a great job!

i called a few different companies trying to get someone to fix my pool's electric heat pump, but nobody could help. finally, i got referred to this pool cleaning company. chris called me back quickly and was able to come out the very next day to repair the heat pump. i'm really happy with how fast and professional the service was. my pool is running great again, and i definitely recommend them if you need any pool cleaning or repair work, especially in this texas heat.

i've been a customer for about 20 years, and the pool service here has always been excellent. during the weekly visits, routine pool cleaning and maintenance are done quickly and carefully by chris, and he always checks the equipment to make sure everything is working right. any repairs i've needed have been handled promptly and at a fair price. mike, who runs the company, really knows a lot about pool equipment, maintenance, and how to fix things the right way. i would definitely give this pool

Plano Pool Service has consistently offered excellent value and insightful guidance on my pool and its upkeep for more than two decades. The team, including Tanner in the local Plano store and David at the service office, are respectful, reliable, and trustworthy. I have developed a high level of trust in their services.

When my pool actuator stopped working right before a freeze, I needed it fixed fast. My regular warranty contact didn’t get back to me for a few days, and my weekly pool cleaning service wanted to charge a $95 trip fee on top of parts and labor. I decided to call another pool cleaning company, and Grant came out the very next day, fixed the problem, and charged a fair price. I’ll definitely call them again for any pool repairs I need.

I recently had my pool pump fixed and Tanner did a fantastic job. He completed the repair in under an hour, which really saved me both time and money. While his communication style might come off as a bit rough, I appreciate that he’s a dedicated worker who knows his stuff. I highly recommend his service, and I would definitely choose them again for my pool needs.

David from Plano Pool Service did an exceptional job transitioning our in-ground saltwater pool from using filters to a sand filter system.
